responsibility: This file implements front-end support for DATA statement initialization after parsing. It maps DATA lvalues onto scalar, array-section, substring, and structure-constructor storage positions, computes section indices and element offsets, applies assignment-style initialization semantics including character/Hollerith padding and truncation, advances multidimensional section iterators, and formalizes resulting constructor order so symbols end up with normalized compile-time initial values consumable by later translation routines.
same_name_distinction: Implements DATA-statement initializer mapping and normalization, including array-section offset calculation, substring/structure handling, assignment into constructors, and final formalization of initial values. Unlike gcc/fortran/data.h, it contains the actual DATA-processing algorithms.
